Name: Lights Out
Overview:
Study the level. Turn off the light. Walk to the goal.

LightsOut is a unique game where you must solve each level using sound, timing and memory. You have 99 seconds to pass the level which is ideal if you have a few minutes before dinner, or even "just one more level" before you go to bed.

There are 10 exciting ways to play. 
Can you pass all 100 levels?
